items.zh: 你今天早上打卡了吗？
items.scene: 早上九点，同事在电梯口碰到你

answers.en: Did you clock in this morning?
answers.note: 最通用的问法，clock in 指上班打卡，语气中性，问同事或主管都不突兀。

answers.en: Did you punch in yet?
answers.note: punch in 更口语，原指老式考勤机打卡，现在电子考勤也常这么说，熟人之间很自然。

answers.en: Did you swipe in this morning?
answers.note: swipe in 指刷工卡过门禁，公司用门禁卡考勤时更贴切，重点是刷卡动作。

items.zh: 我好像忘了打卡，怎么办？
items.scene: 下班前发现考勤记录是空的，问旁边同事

answers.en: I think I forgot to clock in. What should I do?
answers.note: 先说自己忘了再求助，语气平常，适合问关系近的同事，不像正式报备。

answers.en: I missed my clock-in this morning — any idea how to fix it?
answers.note: 把打卡说成 missed my clock-in，像讲流程疏漏，适合问行政怎么补。

answers.en: It looks like I never clocked in today. Can I still fix it?
answers.note: it looks like 留了余地，can I still 是确认还能不能补，语气比前两句谨慎。

items.zh: 打卡机坏了，今天的考勤怎么算？
items.scene: 早上打卡机黑屏，几个人围在前台

answers.en: The time clock is down. How do we log our hours today?
answers.note: time clock 是美式对打卡机的说法，直接问工时怎么记，适合问行政。

answers.en: The clock-in system is down. Should we just write down our hours?
answers.note: 把问题说成系统故障，should we just 带提议，适合和同事商量临时办法。

answers.en: The punch clock is broken. Who do we report our hours to?
answers.note: punch clock 偏老式说法，重点转到找谁报工时，适合问前台或主管。

items.zh: 我堵在路上了，能帮我跟老板说一声吗？
items.scene: 早高峰堵在高架上，你给同事发消息

answers.en: I'm stuck in traffic. Can you let my boss know?
answers.note: 最直接，stuck in traffic 是堵车的固定说法，适合请身边的同事带话。

answers.en: Traffic is terrible — could you give my boss a heads-up?
answers.note: heads-up 指提前知会一声，语气比上一句轻，适合临时告诉主管。

answers.en: I'm caught in traffic and might be late. Would you mind telling my manager?
answers.note: would you mind 最客气，补上 might be late 让对方知道要传什么话。

items.zh: 迟到一次会扣钱吗？
items.scene: 新同事第一天，悄悄问旁边的老员工

answers.en: Do they dock your pay if you're late?
answers.note: dock your pay 是扣工资的常用说法，问老员工时直接，适合私下打听。

answers.en: Is there a penalty for being late?
answers.note: penalty 偏制度用语，像在确认书面规定，适合问人事。

answers.en: Does being late once cost you money here?
answers.note: cost you money 绕开术语，问得委婉，适合刚入职不好意思直说。

items.zh: 三点的会议室你订了吗？
items.scene: 开会前半小时，项目负责人在群里问

answers.en: Did you book the meeting room for three o'clock?
answers.note: book 是订会议室的常用动词，问得直接，平级之间最合适。

answers.en: Do you have the conference room reserved for 3 p.m.?
answers.note: reserved 强调已经订好这个状态，conference room 更正式，适合对上级确认。

answers.en: Is the room locked in for 3 p.m.?
answers.note: locked in 是口语，表示敲定不再改，适合熟悉的同事之间快速确认。

items.zh: 会议室投影仪连不上，能叫人来修吗？
items.scene: 客户马上到，会议室里投影没反应

answers.en: The projector's dead. Can someone come fix it?
answers.note: dead 形容设备彻底没反应，口语又急，适合熟人之间赶紧喊人。

answers.en: I can't get the projector working — can we get IT up here?
answers.note: get IT up here 指把技术的人叫上来，带催促，客户等着时最常用。

answers.en: The projector won't connect. Could you call someone from IT?
answers.note: won't connect 指设备连不上，could you 客气，适合对上级或行政正式求助。

items.zh: 空调能调小一点吗？我快冻僵了。
items.scene: 下午工位上，你穿着外套还在发抖

answers.en: Can we turn the AC down a bit? I'm freezing.
answers.note: turn the AC down 是调小冷气，室温会升高，办公室最常见的中性请求。

answers.en: Could you turn the temperature up? It's like a fridge in here.
answers.note: 不说空调说温度，把重点放在体感上，比直接指挥调空调委婉，适合不太熟的同事。

answers.en: Mind if I turn the AC down? I'm freezing.
answers.note: mind if I 是自己动手前先打招呼，最客气，不给人被指挥的感觉。

items.zh: 空调是不是坏了？一点风都没有。
items.scene: 闷热的下午，同事抬头看天花板出风口

answers.en: Is the AC broken? There's no air at all.
answers.note: 最直白的猜测，broken 指机器坏了，同事之间抬头随口一问。

answers.en: Did the AC go out? I don't feel any air.
answers.note: go out 指设备突然停摆，美式口语常用，带点意外和确认的意味。

answers.en: Is the air conditioning down? There's no airflow at all.
answers.note: air conditioning 是完整说法，be down 指系统停摆，语气冷静，适合报给行政或物业。

items.zh: 打印机又卡纸了，谁来弄一下？
items.scene: 文件要得急，打印机吐出一半纸

answers.en: The printer's jammed again. Can someone take a look?
answers.note: jammed 是卡纸的标准说法，语气平稳，适合在群里喊人来看。

answers.en: Paper jam again — who's good with this thing?
answers.note: 用名词短语更口语，who's good with this thing 半开玩笑地找人，适合熟同事。

answers.en: The printer is jammed again. Could someone from admin help?
answers.note: 完整句加 could，语气正式，适合对行政或上级说。

items.zh: 打印纸没了，仓库还有吗？
items.scene: 打印到一半机器停了，你问行政

answers.en: We're out of paper. Is there more in storage?
answers.note: out of paper 最直接，storage 指储物间，问行政补货时常用。

answers.en: Do we have any printer paper left in the supply closet?
answers.note: supply closet 是美式办公室放耗材的地方，问得更具体，适合确认库存。

answers.en: Ran out of paper — is there a spare box anywhere?
answers.note: 省略主语更口语，spare box 指备用的一箱，适合问旁边同事。

items.zh: 这份材料帮我打印两份行吗？
items.scene: 开会前，你把材料递给邻座同事

answers.en: Can you print two copies of this for me?
answers.note: 最普通的请求，can you 加 for me，平级同事之间直接说。

answers.en: Could you run off two copies of this?
answers.note: run off copies 是打印复印的口语说法，轻松随意，适合关系好的同事。

answers.en: Would you mind printing two copies of this?
answers.note: would you mind 最客气，适合请不熟的人或上级帮忙。

items.zh: 中午一起点外卖吗？
items.scene: 十一点半，同事在工位之间走动

answers.en: Want to order takeout for lunch?
answers.note: takeout 是美式口语里对外卖或外带的常用说法，对着一个同事问，Want to 最随口。

answers.en: Should we get delivery for lunch?
answers.note: get delivery 明确是叫人送餐，几个人商量时用，should we 把决定变成共同的事。

answers.en: Anyone up for takeout for lunch?
answers.note: 在群里问一圈人，anyone up for 不点名，语气最轻松，谁想去谁应。

items.zh: 楼下新开的那家面馆，去试试？
items.scene: 午休前，同事收拾桌面准备下楼

answers.en: There's a new noodle place downstairs — want to try it?
answers.note: 先给信息再邀请，语气轻松，适合关系近的午饭搭子。

answers.en: Should we check out that new noodle spot downstairs?
answers.note: check out 是去看看，should we 是提议，适合几个人一起定午饭。

answers.en: How about that new noodle place downstairs for lunch?
answers.note: How about 把选择权递过去，对方不想去也容易接话，最不施压。

items.zh: 帮我带一份午饭行吗？
items.scene: 同事要下楼吃饭，你走不开

answers.en: Could you grab me something for lunch?
answers.note: grab 是顺手买，语气轻松，适合拜托下楼吃饭的同事。

answers.en: Would you mind picking up lunch for me?
answers.note: would you mind 最客气，picking up 强调顺路取，适合不太熟的人。

answers.en: Can you bring me back something to eat?
answers.note: bring me back 强调带回来，最口语，适合关系好、常互相带饭的同事。

items.zh: 我能跟你换个工位吗？这边靠空调太冷。
items.scene: 你刚入职，座位正对着空调出风口

answers.en: Can I switch desks with you? This one's too close to the AC.
answers.note: switch desks 是换工位，直接说明原因，平级同事之间最常用。

answers.en: Would you be okay swapping seats with me? I'm right under the AC.
answers.note: would you be okay 先问对方意愿，swapping seats 更口语，语气客气。

answers.en: Any chance we could trade desks? Mine's freezing.
answers.note: any chance 是试探式请求，trade desks 强调平等交换，适合不熟的人。

items.zh: 我椅子坏了，去哪儿找行政领新的？
items.scene: 椅背突然塌下去，你站起来找行政

answers.en: My chair's broken. Where do I get a new one?
answers.note: 最直接，先报问题再问去处，适合直接问行政或前台。

answers.en: The back of my chair just gave out. Who do I ask for a replacement?
answers.note: gave out 指突然坏掉，说清坏在哪，再问谁负责换，信息最全。

answers.en: My chair broke — is there a spare one I can grab?
answers.note: spare one 指备用的，grab 很口语，适合先问旁边同事有没有存货。

items.zh: 我明天想请一天假，流程怎么走？
items.scene: 晚上在系统里找请假入口，问同事

answers.en: I want to take tomorrow off. What's the process?
answers.note: 先说要请假再问流程，意思最清楚，适合问行政或主管。

answers.en: I need to take a day off tomorrow. How do I put in for it?
answers.note: put in for it 是美式提交申请的固定说法，适合问同事系统怎么操作。

answers.en: Can I take tomorrow off? How do I submit the request?
answers.note: can I 先征求同意再问提交，语气更谨慎，适合对直属主管说。

items.zh: 病假需要医院证明吗？
items.scene: 感冒发烧，你给人事发消息

answers.en: Do I need a doctor's note for sick leave?
answers.note: doctor's note 是美式医院证明，问制度时最常用，语气中性。

answers.en: Is a doctor's note required for sick days?
answers.note: 被动句更正式，像在逐条确认规定，适合问人事或看制度前核对。

answers.en: Do they ask for proof when you call in sick?
answers.note: call in sick 是打电话请病假，问得口语，适合私下问老同事。

items.zh: 我今年年假还剩几天？
items.scene: 计划国庆出行，打开考勤系统前问人事

answers.en: How many vacation days do I have left?
answers.note: vacation days 是美式年假说法，直接问剩余天数，问人事最清楚。

answers.en: How much PTO do I still have?
answers.note: PTO 指带薪休假，美式职场缩写，同事之间常说，语气更随意。

answers.en: What's my vacation balance for the year?
answers.note: vacation balance 是人事系统里的年假余额，问法更正式，适合直接问人事。

items.zh: 这笔打车费能报销吗？
items.scene: 加班到十点，打车回家前问主管

answers.en: Can I expense the taxi ride?
answers.note: expense 作动词就是报销，美式商务常用，问主管最直接。

answers.en: Will the company cover my cab?
answers.note: cover 指公司承担费用，cab 是出租车口语，语气比上一句轻松。

answers.en: Can I get reimbursed for the taxi?
answers.note: get reimbursed 是正式报销说法，适合问财务或先看制度。

items.zh: 报销单要贴发票吗？
items.scene: 填纸质报销单时卡住，转头问邻座

answers.en: Do I need to attach the receipts to the expense report?
answers.note: attach 指附上票据，expense report 是报销单，问流程时最准确。

answers.en: Do the receipts have to go with the reimbursement form?
answers.note: have to go with 更口语，意思一样但语气松，适合问邻座。

answers.en: Am I supposed to tape the receipts to the form?
answers.note: tape 指用胶带把票据粘上，问的是具体动作，适合确认操作细节。

items.zh: 周末团建必须去吗？
items.scene: 周五下午，群里发了团建通知

answers.en: Do I have to go to the team-building thing this weekend?
answers.note: have to 直接问是不是强制，team-building thing 带点不情愿，适合问熟同事。

answers.en: Is the weekend team event mandatory?
answers.note: mandatory 指硬性规定，语气正式，适合向人事确认制度。

answers.en: Are we expected to go to the team outing this weekend?
answers.note: be expected to 比 have to 软，暗示不去可能不太好，适合试探主管。

items.zh: 团建去哪儿？要爬山我就不去了。
items.scene: 茶水间里，同事讨论团建安排

answers.en: Where's the team outing? If it's hiking, count me out.
answers.note: count me out 是口语，明确说不参加，带玩笑语气，适合熟同事。

answers.en: Where are we going for team building? I'm sitting out if it's a hike.
answers.note: sit out 指不参加某项活动，比 count me out 温和，适合一般同事。

answers.en: What's the plan for the team event? I'll pass if it involves hiking.
answers.note: I'll pass 是礼貌拒绝，语气最收，适合对不太熟的同事说。

items.zh: 今晚是不是又要加班？
items.scene: 六点整，同事关电脑前问你

answers.en: Are we working late again tonight?
answers.note: work late 是加班最常见的说法，again 带疲惫，同事之间常问。

answers.en: Do we have to stay late tonight?
answers.note: have to 强调被迫，带抱怨，适合私下问邻座。

answers.en: Is it another late night tonight?
answers.note: another late night 是名词化说法，更感慨，适合熟同事之间互相吐槽。
